candidate.perspective: Vietnamese listed companies seeking to diversify long-term equity financing beyond a predominantly bank-intermediated funding system.
candidate.structural_condition: Operational emerging-market access channel after FTSE reclassification
candidate.delta: FTSE Secondary Emerging status became effective on 21 September 2026 after concrete market-access reforms, and phased FTSE GEIS inclusion moved from scheduled qualification to live implementation.
candidate.mechanism: Vietnam's move to FTSE Secondary Emerging status became effective on 21 September 2026 after reforms to foreign-investor prefunding, failed-trade handling and global-broker access. FTSE GEIS inclusion is being phased in four tranches through September 2027, turning market-access reform into a live benchmark-eligibility channel rather than a prospective qualification.
catalysts: Successful replication of the September 2026 tranche followed by the March, June and September 2027 FTSE tranches.
Persistent foreign participation outside rebalance windows and broader equity issuance would show that benchmark access is becoming a durable financing channel.
candidate.invalidation: Persistent settlement failures, inability of index trackers to replicate later tranches, or access constraints that prevent durable institutional participation would weaken the classification.
